name: Rajeshwari Cans Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2018, Rajeshwari Cans Ltd manufactures Containers & Packaging products
keyPoints:
Product Profile:[1]
Company manufactures round printed tin containers of sizes 50 Gm/Ml. to 5 Kgs/Liters used for packing of tobacco and snuff. It also manufactures MS Drums available between 5 Kgs to 30 Kgs

pros: Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 33.4 days to 19.0 days
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Debtor days have increased from 48.6 to 61.1 days.
